children: India's Jio Credit has accepted bids worth 17.56 billion rupees ($183.99 million) for bonds maturing in three years, three bankers said on Friday.
It will pay a coupon of 8.08% and had invited bids for the issue on Friday, they said.
The company did not immediately respond to a Reuters email seeking comment.
